key.name: side
key.summary: Screen edge the panel opens from
key.description: Only a two-finger swipe from this touchpad edge opens the panel.

key.name: weather-location
key.description: Name, latitude, and longitude of a place picked in the preferences. An empty name means automatic: the device's location when Location Services are on, otherwise the city of the system time zone.

key.name: weather-city
key.summary: City typed for weather (Ledge 0.3 and earlier)
key.description: Looked up by name when weather-location is empty. The preferences clear it when you pick a place.

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens and closes the panel

key.name: widgets
key.summary: Widgets shown in the panel, in order
key.description: Widgets left out are not loaded at all.

key.name: hot-edge
key.summary: Open the panel by pushing the pointer against the screen edge

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show a top bar button that opens and closes the panel

key.name: auto-update
key.description: Checks GitHub once a day. When off, Ledge only says that a new version is out, once per version.

key.name: update-checked-at
key.summary: When Ledge last checked for a new version (Unix time)

key.name: update-notified
key.summary: The last new version Ledge told you about
